author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hello fellow Avicus forum user!
I was just thinking "What if there was a way to notify Funky of lots of lag without the forum posts?"
I then thought of a system, or meter, to do just that.
With the lagometer, each forum member gets to vote about how bad the lag is (10 is worst; 1 is fine). The votes will then average themselves and be put into the meter.
Staff may edit the entrees if they believe someone is mistaken (voting a 9 when it's really more like a 2), but they shouldn't definitely not be allowed to abuse it or edit them unnecessarily.
I'm not sure if it should be visible or not; suggestions are very welcome :3
What do you think?

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body:
So everyone says how badly they lag...

What will this achieve?

Lag is either server-side or client-side. 
If all server-side lag is gone, people will still complain about lag.

I don't see the point of rating on a scale from 1-10 because unfortunately it wont change anything.
